house.description: Portion of regional transportation sales tax revenue allocated to SouthWest Transit.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

additions: (c) The council must share regional transportation sales tax revenue with all replacement service providers. SouthWest Transit must receive an amount equal to 3.7 percent of the regional transportation sales tax collected in the metropolitan area under section 297A.9915, subdivision 2.
